title: radio count 2 to 5
rule: Radio count — must be more than two, normally fewer than five (all options visible to compare). Dual-cite NN/g handful/dropdown cutoff; Ant names the 2–5 band.
pass_when: Radios are used for more than two and normally fewer than five visible options.
fail_when: Radios for two-or-fewer as this Ant band, or a long set as radios when Ant would use dropdown (>5).
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: One house cutoff vs NN/g handful / Polar <4 / USWDS <7 / M3 6 / Carbon 3. Overlap with extra 73: `nng.too-few-options-radios-not-dropdown` / `polar.select-4plus-choice-list-under-4`. Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.inputs.match_control_and_size`, `dropdown_chooser`, `combo_box`, `offer_choices_not_only_text`.
